variants.name: M, Chicken, 3 pcs / 75 g
variants.about_this_item:
8in1 Delights Chicken Sticks are made of tasty beefhide and delicious chicken breast for intensive, long-lasting chewing fun. The natural abrasive action of chewing removes tartar and supports dental health.

  • Low in fat, rich in proteins
  • Free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers
  • Oven baked, no added GMOs or gluten
variants.feeding_instructions: XS dogs (1–5 kg): 1 treat over seven days. S–L dogs (5 kg +): 1 treat over two days. Treats should not exceed 10% of the daily calorie intake. Choose a chew slightly larger than your dog's mouth, supervise while chewing and always provide fresh water.

variants.name: Beef, 3 pcs / 75 g
variants.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Beef Sticks are made of tasty beefhide and delicious beef meat for intensive, long-lasting chewing fun. While keeping your dog busy, the natural abrasive action of chewing helps remove tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked, free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added GMOs or gluten. Pack of 3 sticks, 75 g.
variants.feeding_instructions: XS dogs (1–5 kg): feed 1 treat over a course of seven days; do not exceed 1 treat in a seven day period. S–L dogs (5+ kg): feed 1 treat over a course of two days; do not exceed 1 treat in a two day period. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Always provide fresh water and supervise your dog while chewing.
